hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/warn-skipped-install.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h" -Root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; else m='warn-skipped-install: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/warn-skipped-install.ps1 was not found: the submodule is not initialised, so this clone was NOT checked for skipped install steps. git submodule update --init fetches it.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi

i=$(cat); case $i in *mod-cache*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-cd-into-mod-cache.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h" -Root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -CacheName .mod-cache; else m='refuse-cd-into-mod-cache: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-cd-into-mod-cache.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the mod-cache hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *npm*|*npx*|*pip*|*gem*|*cargo*|*winget*|*choco*|*scoop*|*release*download*|*.exe*|*.msi*|*.zip*|*.tar.gz*|*.tgz*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/ask-before-download.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h"; else m='ask-before-download: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/ask-before-download.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the download hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *py*'<<'*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-python-heredoc.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h"; else m='refuse-python-heredoc: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-python-heredoc.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the heredoc hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *'`'*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-backtick-substitution.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h"; else m='refuse-backtick-substitution: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-backtick-substitution.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the backtick hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case ${i%%'"tool_input"'*} in *'"tool_name"'*'"PowerShell"'*) exit 0;; esac; c=${i#*'"tool_input"'}; case $c in *cat*|*py*|*'<<'*|*'\\\\\\\\'*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-hanging-bash.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h"; else m='refuse-hanging-bash: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-hanging-bash.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the hanging-bash hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *commit*|*push*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-git-hook-skip.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h"; else m='refuse-git-hook-skip: vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-git-hook-skip.ps1 was not found, so this command was NOT checked by the hook-skip hook. git submodule update --init fetches the script.'; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" "$m"; fi;; esac
